tasks.title: #295: post the Marketplace workaround reply and pin the issue
tasks.notes: Maintainer approved posting now + pin (2026-11-16, option 1). Outward action, gh needs dangerouslyDisableSandbox. Reply content: cause = HA 2026.11 core Marketplace async_pre_install domain check (homeassistant/components/marketplace/repositories/integration.py) vs a stale LaggAt/hacs-govee record still marked installed after the HACS->Marketplace migration; not caused by v2026.11.0; link home-assistant/core#190454. Workaround: Settings > Devices & services > Devices, search Marketplace, open it, disable the integration; back up /config/.storage/marketplace.repositories; in the LaggAt/hacs-govee record delete only the "installed": true line; save, re-enable, retry update. WARNING: never 'Delete and uninstall' the LaggAt entry (deletes custom_components/govee and the config entry). Mention we are proposing a core fix. Ask no more 'same here' comments (use reactions). Cite no version of ours. Keep issue open. Pin: gh issue pin 295.
